title: Magnifying-glass illustration loop
slide_intent: Animate a focal detail rather than every part because viewers need a stable subject while noticing a small surprise.
strategic_value: An eye, plants and small figures moving within the rough drawing can give Mailchimp’s illustration a curious personality.
demonstration: The large figure holds a magnifying glass while the eye and smaller plant-like characters change in a short white-backed loop.
practical_value: Compare localized motion with the largely fixed silhouette of an illustration.

content_islands.name: Large figure
content_islands.spec: Keep the oversized hand and upper body as the stable left mass.

content_islands.name: Small actions
content_islands.spec: Animate the eye and small figures near the magnifying glass and plants at right.

reference_purposes.Expression: The loop preserves rough black linework while changing the eye and small characters.
